newsitem.title: USA: American Intl sees yr-end positive cashflow.
newsitem.headline: American Intl sees yr-end positive cashflow.

text.p: American International Petroleum Corp said Friday that it expects operations to be cash-flow positive by year's end, after reporting narrowing third quarter and nine-month per share losses.
The company reported a third quarter per share loss of $0.02 on a net loss of $743,000, compared to a $0.03 per share loss on net losses of $675,000 in the 1995 third quarter.
Nine-month per share loss was down to $0.05 on $1.5 million in net losses, compared to $0.13 per share loss on net losses of $2.7 million in the 1995 nine-month period.

"On a cash basis, our operations were only $36,000 away from break-even for the third quarter this year," the company said in a release. "Should this trend continue, we expect our operations to be cash-flow positive by year-end."
The company said its projection is also based on a 33 percent increase in daily oil production in Colombia and significant inroads in company-wide cost-cutting.
